pr_body:
If the complex geometry contains only points that all resolve (quantize) to the same single point, then the entire geometry is identical to a single point, and the point and the geometry are both inside and contain each other.

Fixes #93889
pr_title: Fix test bug with extra small complex geometries
pr_comment: Shall we back-port it to 8.7.0 and 8.6.3?

review_comment: I only coded support for Line, not any other geometries, but we could expand this to others. Right now supporting Line will fix the reported flaky test. I presume the chances of more complex geometries also hitting this problem go down with increasing complexity, so we might not need to care about them.
I think this is enough, I thought in the same fix.
